# dinsor-design

> Warm-paper design system: ink green accent, serif display, sans body, flat surfaces. Plain CSS, no build step to use.

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): start here. Setup, rules, lint command
- [components/](components/): copy-paste markup, one file per component
- [templates/page.html](templates/page.html): starter page
- [dist/tokens.md](dist/tokens.md): every allowed value
- [dist/dinsor.css](dist/dinsor.css): the stylesheet (tokens, base, components, fonts)
- [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md): rationale and rules
- [scripts/lint.mjs](scripts/lint.mjs): enforcement
